title: ZUVYR Universal Intent Delegation + Messaging/App Automation Overlay
principle: Persist user intent as a bounded, versioned authority policy that can drive connector, messaging, browser and device actions across the task without per-click approval inside the granted scope.

whatsapp_reference.target: WhatsApp Business/Cloud API when legitimate provider/account access is available
whatsapp_reference.browser_role: setup/admin fallback only when appropriate and provider-permitted
whatsapp_reference.launch_rule: current platform rules, templates/message restrictions, rate limits, opt-outs and account prerequisites must be verified in PACK149

consequence_tiers.A: reversible low-risk actions may auto-execute under standing authority
consequence_tiers.B: bounded sends/publishes/updates may auto-execute only when explicitly covered by standing policy and receipts
consequence_tiers.C: high-consequence financial, destructive, security, sensitive-disclosure, legal or major-publication actions require stronger applicable consequence policy/confirmation unless narrowly and safely pre-authorized

PACK101: persist mission/policy/cursor across surfaces and reconnect
PACK127: ordinary multi-step website task without per-click approval
PACK144: delegation state and receipts across clients

requirements.UIA-01: Durable user mission across app/browser actions
requirements.UIA-02: ALWAYS_ALLOW_APP authorizes bounded execution, not only OAuth consent
requirements.UIA-08: Event dedupe and exactly-once external action receipts
requirements.UIA-09: Ordinary multi-step browser completion without per-click prompts
requirements.UIA-10: Connector/API-first browser/device fallback without intent loss
requirements.UIA-11: Background execution schedules and quiet-hour policy
requirements.UIA-14: Untrusted inbound content cannot widen authority/exfiltrate context
requirements.UIA-15: Consequence-tier enforcement with minimal unnecessary interruption
requirements.UIA-16: WhatsApp/business-messaging reference workflow when legitimately connectable
requirements.UIA-20: Final production E2E and recovery proof
